citations.text: Han, T. A., Pereira, L. M., Santos, F. C., & Lenaerts, T. (2020). To regulate or not: A social dynamics analysis of an idealised AI race. Journal of Artificial Intelligence Research, 69, 881-921.

en.general: A situation in which several developers compete to be first with a powerful AI technology, so that each is tempted to cut safety precautions to move faster. It is studied as a social dilemma, in which what suits each developer differs from what is good for all. Wording for students: everyone hurries, and the risk falls on everyone.

examples: Two companies that each choose between releasing now and testing first, where releasing first wins the market and shared harm falls on the public.
